project.title: Aquascape V2 — generated individual artwork
project.description: Correct the rejected scenery prototype by generating complete designed individual props first. The shape, silhouette, painted light, wear and species leaf forms must come from generated artwork and be retained during later 3D reconstruction. This stage produces four original art assets for direct fish-style comparison, not generic material swatches.
project.art_direction: Match the supplied silver arowana illustration's detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART: deliberate crisp pixel clusters, rich carefully painted midtones, delicate highlights, restrained believable colors, readable asymmetrical silhouettes. Detailed hand-painted game sprite appearance with dimensional painted volume. NO low-poly CGI, NO procedural primitive look, NO 3D render, NO photographic grain, NO uniform noise or smooth airbrush. The fish reference establishes the exact drawing finish, not subject matter.
project.gameplay_loop: Review generated aquarium scenery artwork and later reconstruct its designed shapes in 3D.
project.session_goal: Four complete isolated source illustrations, visually reviewed alongside the original fish before any model construction. Keep full native image resolution and source provenance.
project.visual_reference_usage: North-star full-screen mock at project viewport resolution (1536x1024). Align palette, line weight, and mood with art_direction — not pixel-perfect. Do NOT use as img2img input for character/icon sprites; those use assets[].display_size on white studio.

asset.name: java_fern_master
asset.description: Generate ONE complete Microsorum pteropus clump, common Java fern / Tie Huang Guan, as a finished detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART aquarium game prop, isolated on pure white with generous margin. Orthographic broad front with a slight top/right view. Correct simple-leaved form, NOT Windelov cultivar: 8 to 10 individually recognizable long lanceolate undivided leathery green leaves from a short exposed creeping rhizome. Tallest blades upright at the back; two older blades arch outward, small newer blades closer to the rhizome; asymmetry and clear spaces between leaf groups. Leaf length 16–28cm, width 2–4cm, gentle tapered tip and slightly wavy whole margin, broad readable central midrib and subtle netted lateral veins. Paint each leaf's distinct folding, tilt, twisting light and dark planes in the supplied fish's naturalistic PIXEL ART finish. Dark forest green and muted olive highlights, no neon yellow or repeated green noise. Fine hanging roots remain visible; no pot, soil, rock, wood, background scenery or water. No featherlike fronds, serrated fern leaflets, split tips or radial identical spikes. Complete plant with all tips and roots visible. No fish, no CGI, no photographic detail, no cast shadow, no labels/text/collage. This is the complete designed source plant, not a generic leaf texture.

plan.prompt:
Subject: One Microsorum pteropus clump: 8–10 long lanceolate undivided leathery leaves rising from a short exposed creeping rhizome; tallest blades upright at back, two older blades arching outward, small new blades near the rhizome; fine hanging roots visible.
Silhouette: Asymmetric fan of distinct leaf groups with clear gaps between them; gently wavy tapered tips; broad readable central midribs.
Style lock: Soft style alignment with art direction; prefer cohesive look over literal copy.; Detailed naturalistic pixel art: crisp deliberate pixel clusters, carefully painted midtones, dark forest green with muted olive highlights, folded light and dark leaf planes; not uniform noise.
View: Side view, profile facing right, readable silhouette for side-scroller gameplay; Orthographic side profile with slight top-right elevation, whole plant visible.
Technical: Pure flat white background (#FFFFFF), uniform studio backdrop; single object centered; mattable still; no environment scenery; Pure flat white #FFFFFF studio background, generous margin, every tip and root inside frame, no cast shadow.
Negatives: No spritesheet; no multiple action frames in one image; never transparent background or checkerboard; No pot, soil, rock, wood, water or scenery; no Windelov feathery or serrated fronds; no neon yellow; no smooth airbrush; no CGI, photo, text, collage, fish.
negative_hints: Do not prompt for transparent background or checkerboard.
Do not include multiple characters or action frames.
Do not include borders, frames, vignettes, gradients, or textured backdrops.
Character sprite only — not a prison scene, not environmental background, not item icon.
No prison walls, bars, cells, floors, or scenery behind the character.
